events.mesbox: You carry the various instruments onto the heights... As promised, you also transport one of the crabs.
Whilst that music must sound absolutely amazing to crabs, it's a little too... avant-garde for your tastes. You choose to imagine different music instead.

events.say: Let's remain seated for the rest of the performance.

events.mesbox: The crabs dance for hours and hours...
The crabs dance for hours and hours...
As the day draws to an end, you suddenly feel very tired. You close your eyes...
